(* outer (* nested *) still a comment *)
datatype shape = Circle of real | Rect of real * real
fun area (Circle r) = 3.14 * r * r
  | area (Rect (w, h)) = w * h
fun greet name times =
  let val text = "Hello, " ^ name ^ "!\n"
  in if times > 0 andalso true then print text else ()
  end
val x' = SOME 42
val c = #"x"
